editorial:
Imagine your whole life falling apart in a single week. That is exactly where you find Markey Marlowe, a rising star who loses her fame, her money, and her friends all at once. She ends up hiding out in a weird duplex with a landlord who keeps to himself and acts very strange. From the start, you get a feeling that something is wrong. The vibe is tense and creepy, making you wonder who is actually the predator and who is the prey in this house. It feels like a dangerous game of cat and mouse where neither person is telling the full truth.

You will really like how the tension builds up slowly until it finally snaps. The acting is solid, and the twists keep you guessing until the very end. While some parts of the story move a bit slow, the payoff is totally worth it. If you enjoy thrillers that take place in one location, you should definitely check this out. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick watch, or if you want the best picture, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the gritty details.
endingExplained: The big twist reveals that the landlord is not just a weird guy, but a dangerous predator who targets vulnerable women. Markey finds out he has been watching her every move. In the final fight, she has to use her wits to survive. She eventually overpowers him and manages to escape the house just in time. It ends with her finally breaking free from both her toxic past and her captor.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological games and survival stories.
